researcher.name: Prof. Truc-Nam (Nam T.) Dinh
researcher.affiliation: Department of Nuclear Engineering, North Carolina State University (formerly Idaho National Laboratory, UC Santa Barbara, KTH)

pillars.title: Nearly Autonomous Management & Control (NAMAC) and Reasoning-Based Discrepancy Checkers
pillars.summary: Three-layer autonomous reactor operation architecture pairing Diagnosis Digital Twins, Prognosis Digital Twins, and Strategy Assessment with an independent Reasoning-Based / Generative-AI Discrepancy Checker that cross-checks recommendations against conservation laws, sensor drift, and directional safety rules before actuation.

pillars.title: Quantitative Digital-Twin Trustworthiness, Out-of-Distribution (OOD) Detection & Data Coverage (FFCM)
pillars.summary: Quantifies operational reliability of neural closures and digital twins under scarce accident data using Flow/State Feature Coverage Mapping (FFCM), out-of-distribution Mahalanobis/density bounds, dynamic model-agnostic reliability evaluation, and Bayesian Belief Network trustworthiness propagation.

pillars.short: III. Generative/Agentic AI for PIRT, EMDAP & STPA
pillars.title: Generative & Multi-Agent AI for PIRT Formulation, NRC EMDAP Licensing & STPA Hazard Analysis
pillars.proximab_gate: PIRTGate, STPAFilter, Arena Governance AR01–AR08 (FM-1.4, FM-3.3)
pillars.summary: Evaluates and structures LLMs and multi-agent workflows for safety-critical nuclear knowledge abstraction: formulating Phenomena Identification and Ranking Tables (PIRT), structuring NRC Regulatory Guide 1.203 EMDAP licensing evidence, and performing System-Theoretic Process Analysis (STPA).

pillars.short: IV. Digital I&C Risk & RESHA Software CCF
pillars.title: Safety-Related Digital I&C Risk Assessment, Redundancy-Guided STPA (RESHA) & Software CCF Defense
pillars.summary: DOE LWRS / INL / NC State integrated risk-assessment methodology (RESHA) tracing hardware and software Common-Cause Failures (CCF), Unsafe Control Actions, and Human-System Interface hazards across redundant safety-related digital instrumentation and control divisions.

pillars.short: V. PCMQ-BN, Bayesian VVUQ & Margin Characterization
pillars.title: Predictive Capability Maturity Quantification (PCMQ-BN), PRA-Driven Bayesian V&V & RISMC
pillars.summary: Formalizes simulation validation under data scarcity and scale distortion as a quantitative Bayesian decision problem (PCMQ-BN), integrating CASL VERA credibility assessments, CSAU/EMDAP scaling analysis, and Risk-Informed Safety Margin Characterization (RISMC).

pillars.short: VI. SciML Taxonomy (Type I–V) & Multiscale Hi2Lo
pillars.title: Chang–Dinh SciML Framework Classification (Type I–V), Modular Bayesian UQ & Data-Driven Hi2Lo
pillars.summary: Establishes the five-type taxonomy for coupling machine learning with conservation equations (Type I black-box vs. Type II–V physics-evaluated/integrated closures), modular Bayesian inverse UQ for boiling/multiphase CFD, and High-to-Low (Hi2Lo) coarse-grid error-correcting thermal-hydraulic solvers.
